description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeSalaryDao component within the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing salary data access operations like save, delete, retrieve, and count for employee salaries.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test suite for EmployeeSalaryDao, verifying CRUD operations, retrieval, and querying of employee salary data.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, creates EmployeeSalaryDao instance, and populates test data from fixture.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeSalary
methods.description: Tests saving a new employee salary record without direct debit.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeSalaryWithEmployeeDirectDebit
methods.description: Tests saving a new employee salary record with associated direct debit details.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeSalaries
methods.description: Verifies deletion of individual salary records.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeSalariesBulk
methods.description: Verifies bulk deletion of multiple salary records.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeSalary
methods.description: Tests retrieval of specific employee salary records under various conditions.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeSalaries
methods.description: Tests fetching list of employee salaries with filtering and sorting.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeSalariesCount
methods.description: Verifies counting of employee salary records based on filter parameters.
